explanation: Once the dustpan is next to the fridge, do not grasp it again.
Only place the dustpan next to the fridge if it is currently held.
Once the bucket is next to the countertop, do not grasp it again.
Only place the bucket next to the countertop if it is currently held.
Once the scraper is on top of the fridge, do not grasp it again.
Only place the scraper on the fridge if it is currently held.
Only place the paper towel on the countertop if it is in the kitchen (i.e., available).
Once the rag is inside the sink, do not place it there again.
Only place the rag inside the sink if the robot is holding it.
Once the rag is soaked, do not soak it again.
Only soak the rag if the sink is currently toggled on.
After the pomelo is in the bucket, do not grasp the bucket just for that fruit again.
Once the pomelo is in the bucket, no need to reposition the bucket for that purpose.
After the pear is in the bucket, do not grasp the bucket again for that fruit.
Once the pear is in the bucket, avoid repositioning the bucket again for that fruit.
After the pea is in the bucket, do not grasp the bucket again for that fruit.
Once the pea is in the bucket, avoid repositioning the bucket again for that fruit.
